subject: PrimeLedger MAP kickoff — GRC & SOC 2 POC alignment
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Kumar <aditi.kumar@primeledger.com>, Tom Becker <t.becker@primeledger.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: PrimeLedger MAP kickoff — GRC & SOC 2 POC alignment

Hi Aditi / Tom —

Thanks again for a great call this morning. Per our conversation I’m kicking off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align timelines and owners for your SOC 2 evaluation and the product evaluation window. The goal: 6–8 week readiness + evaluation, with a go/no-go milestone before procurement signoff.

Quick asks to get the MAP populated this week: 
- Confirm your SOC 2 evidence owner and their preferred contact details (name + email).
- Share any blackout dates or procurement constraints in December.
- Confirm a target date for a 1–2 hour architecture review (we suggested 12/10 or 12/14).

I’ve attached a first-pass MAP workbook with proposed milestones and a short SOC 2 roster request PDF to collect evidence owners. Soojin (cc’d) will be your security lead from Redwood — she’ll own the evidence checklist and the technical deep-dive. Laura will coordinate onboarding and eval logistics. Vivek is looped for any exec-level questions.

Next steps: if you can reply by EOD Thursday with owners and preferred review slots, we’ll lock the MAP and send calendar invites.

Thanks,

Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | (415) 555-0128

Attachments: PrimeLedger_MAP_v1.xlsx (workbook), SOC2_Roster_Request.pdf (fillable roster)

From: Aditi Kumar <aditi.kumar@primeledger.com>

Cc: Tom Becker <t.becker@primeledger.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PrimeLedger MAP kickoff — GRC & SOC 2 POC alignment

Hi Marcus —

Thanks — this looks good. I’ll be the primary GRC contact for SOC 2 evidence collection (Aditi Kumar, GRC Manager). Please mark me down.

For the architecture review, 12/14 10:00–11:30 PT works better for our infra and privacy team. Procurement has a soft freeze from 12/23–01/03, so we need to have contracts close before 12/22 to avoid delay.

I’ve attached a redlined list of a couple of items we typically ask for (data retention clarification + audit log format) — I’ll upload the structured roster by Thursday.

Best,
Aditi
GRC Manager, PrimeLedger
aditi.kumar@primeledger.com

Attachments: data-retention-questions.txt (notes), SOC2_Roster_Request_filled_template.pdf (to follow)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Kumar <aditi.kumar@primeledger.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PrimeLedger MAP kickoff — GRC & SOC 2 POC alignment

Hi Aditi —

Great to meet you virtually. I’ll be your primary security POC on the Redwood side and will drive the SOC 2 evidence collection. To make the evidence pass efficient we’ll follow a two-track approach: 

1) Evidence collection (weeks 1–3): we’ll request exports or access to the artifacts listed in the attached PDF. If anything is sensitive we can accept redacted samples or short recordings/walkthroughs.
2) Technical deep-dive & eval support (weeks 3–6): we’ll run the architecture review and a scoped evaluation against your agreed prompts and data-handling rules.

I’ve noted your procurement blackout (12/23–01/03) and will prioritize having the readiness signoff before 12/22. Proposed calendar:
- 12/03 — MAP baseline finalized (owners committed)
- 12/10 — Internal readiness checkpoint (Redwood)
- 12/14 10:00 PT — Architecture review (confirmed)
- 12/21 — Evaluation findings & readiness signoff
- 12/22 — Procurement handoff / contract queue

Two small asks from my side: 
- Can you provide an account-level data flow diagram (high level) prior to the architecture review? PNG or PDF is fine.
- Please list which PrimeLedger environments (prod, staging, test) will be in-scope for the eval.

I’ve attached a lightweight data-flow template (data-flow-diagram.png) and updated MAP workbook with milestone owners filled where possible. I’ll add specific evidence IDs into the MAP once your roster comes in.

Talk soon — I’ll send calendar invites for 12/14 after Marcus confirms attendees.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Security Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Attachments: data-flow-diagram.png (template), PrimeLedger_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated with owners)

Subject: Re: PrimeLedger MAP kickoff — GRC & SOC 2 POC alignment

All —

Thanks for pulling this together. I’m copying Maya (infra lead) who will join the architecture review and provide the data-flow diagram. We’ll scope eval to prod + staging only. Expect the filled roster and a PNG export of our diagram by Thursday EOB.

Appreciate the clear timeline — we’ll do our best to hit the 12/22 procurement queue.

Cheers,
